name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f 03_Code/packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <03_Code/packages.txt; [ -f 03_Code/requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r 03_Code/requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: cd 03_Code && streamlit run app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
